turns.text: Hey Lloyd, can you help me draft a quick reply to Sarah about the Q3 budget? I'm stuck.
Sure! What are the key points you want to convey regarding the budget adjustments?

Mainly that we need to cut costs on cloud infrastructure. Also, I was reading some stuff on agentic workflows for engineering. Itamar Friedman claims they only deliver about 1.5x efficiency gains right now. Seems modest.
That’s a reasonable target for early adoption. Would you like me to frame the budget cuts around optimizing those specific workflows?
Yes, please. Also, did you see it’s going to rain this weekend? I need to reschedule my hiking trip.
I can draft the budget email and also suggest indoor activities for the weekend if you'd like.
Just the email draft for now. Keep it professional but concise.
Understood. I'll focus on the cost reduction strategies linked to workflow efficiency.
Lloyd, I need to update the presentation slides for the team meeting. The data on efficiency gains has changed.
Noted. What is the new figure we should be using?

Itamar Friedman has updated his stance. He now argues that dynamic agentic workflows are essential for 2x–10x gains, not the lower number I mentioned before. Also, my coffee maker broke again. Any recommendations?
I'll note the new efficiency range for the slides. For coffee makers, are you looking for a specific price range or feature set?
Mid-range, preferably with a built-in grinder. But let's stick to the slides. I need to put this new number in the 'Projected Impact' section.
Got it. I will prepare the text for the 'Projected Impact' section using the updated efficiency metrics.
Great. Just give me the exact string to paste into that field.
Sure, let me know if you need any other updates for the deck.
